name: io.github.dockndevai/ossian-mcp
description: Ask your own documents with citations, plus durable memory for agents. Safe by default.

environmentVariables.name: OSSIAN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Ossian installation (e.g. http://localhost:8081).

environmentVariables.name: OSSIAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ossian API key (osk_…). Scope it to the narrowest role/namespace that works.

environmentVariables.name: OSSIAN_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Separates one agent's memories from another's. Defaults to 'mcp'.

environmentVariables.name: OSSIAN_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.
